_comment: Provisioned kiosk/browser policy templates. An exam must reference one of these by name; the server stores the resolved policy body. Production deployments must ship a catalog reviewed and signed through the normal release process.

policies.name: kiosk-strict
policies.description: Single-purpose kiosk: no downloads, no printing, no developer tools, clipboard disabled, fullscreen enforced.

policies.name: kiosk-standard
policies.description: Kiosk with controlled clipboard and navigation, used for exams that permit pasting a worked answer.

policies.name: supervised-browser
policies.description: Supervised browser with the extension installed and popup-free navigation.
